title: Topic 19
japanese_text: 私はこれまで<u>円満な</u>家庭を築いてきた。しかし、<u>配偶者</u>が<u>ギャンブル</u>にはまって、大金を<u>賭け</u>ていたことが発覚し、家庭は<u>崩壊</u>した。相手は反省し、自分のしたことを悔やんでいるが、許すつもりはない。
english_translation: Up until now, I've raised a harmonious family. However, my family fell apart when I discovered my spouse had become addicted to gambling and had gambled away a large sum of money. My partner is sorry and regrets what he's done, but I have no intention of forgiving him.
